services.desc: All Star Fishing Charters are Puget Sound Salmon Fishing Experts and concentrate on Salmon fishing when Salmon fishing is open. Lingcod fishing trips are available when Lingcod fishing is open. Flounder fishing charters are available all year. Washington Department of Fish and Wildlife set the seasons. the regulations booklet runs on a fiscal year from May 1 thru April 30 and there is always the possibility of emergency rules that change the opening and or closing dates of some fishery.
